mapper.select: SELECT distinct c.USER_ID as userId ,d.NAME as userName FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.commonFileId and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE b.USER_ID = #{userId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

SELECT a.ID as id,c.FILE_NAME as fileName, c.USER_ID as userId ,a.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.commonFileId and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} and b.USER_ID = #{sessionUserId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

SELECT a.ID as id,c.FILE_NAME as fileName, b.USER_ID as userId ,a.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.commonFileId and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
